compiled_state.title: T4: Implement STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX env var in detect-session-leakage.sh (GREEN)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context
Story: 7cf8-84fc-c5ea-48ff — sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body

## Goal
Add STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX env var support to plugins/dso/scripts/detect-session-leakage.sh — replace all 3 hardcoded 'story/' prefixes (Cases 1, 2, 4). Remove RED marker from .test-index.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/detect-session-leakage.sh | modify | tests/scripts/test-detect-session-leakage.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open plugins/dso/scripts/detect-session-leakage.sh
2. Near the top (after the existing DSO_MAIN_BRANCH env var default, at the env-var configuration section), add:
   STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX="${STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX:-story}"
3. Replace hardcoded 'story/' in Case 2 (orphan branch):
   Anchor: ORPHAN_BRANCH="story/orphan-${SESSION_BRANCH}"
   Replace with: ORPHAN_BRANCH="${STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX}/orphan-${SESSION_BRANCH}"
4. Replace hardcoded 'story/' in Case 4 (force-route target):
   Anchor: TARGET_BRANCH="story/${FORCE_EPIC}/${FORCE_ROUTE_TO}"
   Replace with: TARGET_BRANCH="${STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX}/${FORCE_EPIC}/${FORCE_ROUTE_TO}"
5. Replace hardcoded 'story/' in Case 1 (open story target):
   Anchor: TARGET_BRANCH="story/${STORY_EPIC}/${STORY_ID}"
   Replace with: TARGET_BRANCH="${STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX}/${STORY_EPIC}/${STORY_ID}"
6. Remove RED marker for detect-session-leakage.sh from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- detect-session-leakage.sh has STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX env var with default 'story'
- All 3 branch construction sites (Cases 1, 2, 4) use the env var instead of hardcoded 'story/'
- Default behavior unchanged: no STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX → branches use 'story/' prefix
- RED marker removed from .test-index for detect-session-leakage.sh
- Running test suite: previously-RED tests now PASS (GREEN)
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- Script header Usage comment updated to document STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX env var and default value
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
